name: e2e
description: Playwright end-to-end tests for Varaamo, ported from the tilavarauspalvelu-robot Robot Framework suite

scripts.test:all: playwright test --grep-invert @serialonly --project 'Tests_*' --project create_data; parallel=$?; PLAYWRIGHT_HTML_OUTPUT_DIR=playwright-report/notifications PLAYWRIGHT_JUNIT_OUTPUT_FILE=test-results/notifications/junit.xml playwright test --project Tests_admin_notifications_serial --workers 1 --output test-results/notifications; notifications=$?; exit $((parallel || notifications))
